scope: Map source detector centers via the frozen TPV headers into companion frames. For M8, compare the above-both and zero groups in the 100 s exposure against 30 s and 45 s, and the above-both group in the 45 s exposure against 30 s. For M20, compare each 180 s top 0.1 percent (ties included) against 30 s as a geometric control. Report nonzero samples below conservative thresholds under nearest, all four enclosing pixel centers, and the 4 by 4 neighborhood that extends that footprint by one pixel on each side. No measured registration, linearity, PSF agreement, or flux reference.
